method: A throwaway script drove the deployed build in two separate desktop Chromium profiles, on the development backend with a synthetic test account. The session was injected into the app's storage because tests cannot open an emailed link.
checks: build-info.json at the test address names the pinned source and 0.5.3, with CI run 41744222524
The deployed bundle uses the development Supabase and PowerSync hosts
Signed out, no request went to the backend
A course and its student made on desktop reach the server
A second profile with another course is asked before replacing
Replace followed by a page refresh finishes on the online course, with its student: the path that stayed stuck on 0.5.2
An edit on that desktop reaches the server, and the first profile shows it once reloaded
The status reaches Copia online aggiornata, with no uncaught page errors
runs: Four earlier runs of the script failed on the script's own waits: the app correctly keeps the current screen on reload. Captures from those runs showed the app in the expected state. The fifth, the only one recorded here, passed every check.
notChecked: The update from 0.5.2 in place, and a device already stuck on 0.5.2's restore screen: both are in the owner's B4-PHONE-UPLOADS recheck. The sign-in email, and an open screen on one device while the other edits, were not exercised.
